facts.fact: An Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) household gets 35 kg of foodgrains per household per month
facts.quote: While AAY households, which constitute poorest of the poor are entitled to 35 kg of foodgrains per family per month

facts.fact: The grain is free of cost: free distribution to NFSA (AAY and PHH) beneficiaries under PMGKAY has been extended for five years from 1 January 2024
facts.quote: The period of distribution for free of cost food grains under the PMGKAY has been extended for five years w.e.f. 1st January, 2024.

summary: Confirmed: AAY 35 kg per household per month (nfsa.gov.in) and free of cost under PMGKAY for five years from 1 Jan 2024 (PIB DFPD Year End Review 2025).
